info.title: Unju API
info.description:
# Unju API - Multi-Modal AI Gateway

A comprehensive API gateway for AI services including:
- **LLM Completions** - OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini compatible endpoints
- **Realtime API** - WebSocket-based streaming for voice/text
- **Media Generation** - Video, image, and audio generation
- **Agent System** - A2A protocol, agent management, memory
- **Credits & Billing** - ERC20-style token ledger for usage tracking

## Authentication

All authenticated endpoints require either:
- **Bearer Token**: `Authorization: Bearer {api_key}`
- **API Key Header**: `X-API-Key: {api_key}`

## Rate Limits

Rate limits are configured per API key. Check `X-RateLimit-*` headers in responses.

## Credits

Usage is tracked in credits (1 credit ≈ $1 USD). Check balance at `/v1/credits/balance`.
